title: AI-Assisted Software Engineering
summary: The horizontal track that runs alongside every stage: direct AI well, and keep ownership of what you build.

modules.title: Understanding the AI-era developer
modules.summary: How the work of a developer changes with AI, and what does not change.

lessons.title: The five principles
lessons.summary: Understand, Direct, Build, Verify, Own: the habits that make AI a multiplier instead of a crutch.
objectives: Name the five principles and what each asks of you
Explain why AI output must be verified
Describe the three categories of technical competence

modules.title: Working with AI coding assistants

lessons.title: How AI coding assistants work
lessons.summary: Understand what an assistant really does, where it goes wrong, how to protect what you paste, and the working loop that keeps you in charge.
objectives: Explain that an assistant predicts likely text and does not run or check code
Name four ways assistants go wrong
Keep secrets and personal data out of prompts
Apply the Understand, Direct, Build, Verify, Own loop

modules.summary: What assistants are, where they fail, and how to use them safely.

modules.title: Prompting for software development

lessons.title: Writing prompts that work
lessons.summary: Turn a vague request into a small specification with a goal, context, constraints, an example and a format, and learn to ask for a plan first.
objectives: Write a prompt with the five parts
Use an example input and output as a test
Ask for a plan before code
Report a wrong answer in a way that helps

modules.summary: Give assistants instructions they can act on.

modules.title: Reading and understanding AI-generated code

lessons.title: Reading code you did not write
lessons.summary: A routine for reviewing generated code: state its purpose, trace an example, try to break its assumptions, check that what it uses is real, and look for security smells.
objectives: Trace generated code by hand on a small input
List and test the assumptions in a function
Check that imports and functions actually exist
Recognise SQL injection and fix it with a parameterized query

modules.summary: Review code you did not write before you keep it.

modules.title: AI-assisted debugging

lessons.title: Debugging with an AI partner
lessons.summary: Reproduce and shrink a bug, give an assistant a precise report, ask for hypotheses you can test, and tell a root-cause fix from one that hides the symptom.
objectives: Reproduce and shrink a bug
Write a bug report an assistant can use
Distinguish a symptom from a root cause
Confirm a fix by rerunning the original failing case

modules.summary: Debug with an assistant as a partner, not an oracle.

modules.title: AI-assisted software design

lessons.title: Design before you build
lessons.summary: Settle the data shape and the function interfaces first, prefer pure functions, ask for alternatives and trade-offs, and build in small verified steps.
objectives: Define the data shape before the functions
Write function interfaces and examples first
Explain what a pure function is
Compare two designs by their trade-offs

modules.summary: Decide the shape of a program before generating code.
